text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak discusses future of the peace process with Israeli opposition Labour leader Ehud Barak.
- In the first cabinet meeting after the reshuffle, Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif chooses eight ministerial groups to defend national development movements.
- Mubarak says unfortunately some foreign countries have an anti-Islam movement.
- Mubarak meets head of the Higher Constitutional court.
- Mubarak says the anti-Islam movements are unjust, since Islam hopes for peace and unity between nations.
- Egypt's security forces ban Israeli passenger from entering the country.
- 64 million pounds traded on Wednesday in the bourse.
- Mubarak meets winners of primary school religion contests as part of an effort to promote understanding of Islam's aims.
- Barak praises Egypt's role in defending the peace process.
